adriana-cabrera.text: Says LACCD's budget should be "a statement of priorities" and that public tax funding must reach the people it serves. Proposes a 'Local First LACCD Investment Plan' so district dollars support local small and worker-owned businesses.

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes on-campus legal workshops with advocates on housing rights, wage theft, immigration defense and credit protection; her campaign names "the undocumented student wondering if college is possible" as a core constituency.

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes expanding East LA College's business incubator model to all nine campuses to launch "Undocu-Startups" and immigrant-led businesses, with non-taxpayer revenue earmarked for paid student jobs and scholarships.

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes a 'Public Access Standard' moving major board budget votes to evenings or weekends, and a budget process giving student governments and labor unions "a structural seat at the table before budgets are finalized."

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes a centralized 'No Wrong Door' services model on all nine campuses and a Student Parent Success Plan; cites housing insecurity and lack of childcare as reasons students drop out.

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes using Measure LA funds to replace asphalt with tree canopy on campuses, a Healthy Green Campuses Initiative, and workforce certificates in solar operations and stormwater management.

source.title: Adriana Cabrera for LACCD - Priorities

adriana-cabrera.text: Proposes translating all board agendas and policy papers into the district's primary languages and distributing them well before votes.
